text: Registered primary comparison: adding AdamW decoupled weight decay (0.01) to the fixed ReLU MLP does not change test accuracy relative to decay 0. Across seeds 0-2 the two arms make identical argmax predictions on all 360 test examples, so the paired difference is exactly zero and the bootstrap interval is degenerate.
limitations: Test-set argmax identity at n=360 with three seeds only. Zero discordant pairs gives no sign information, so this shows the intervention is too small to flip a prediction here, not that decay is equivalent to no decay. Only the registered decay value and budget were tested.

text: The registered sensitivity arm (weight decay 0.001) also yields test predictions identical to the unregularized arm on all seeds, so the accuracy effect is null across both tested non-zero decay values.
limitations: Only two non-zero decay values were tested, both under the same learning rate and 850-step budget. No claim about larger decay or longer training.

text: The shuffled-label control reaches near-chance test accuracy on every seed, so the test pipeline does not recover labels that are unrelated to the inputs.
limitations: Negative control for label leakage at one training budget. It does not test memorisation under longer training. The shuffled arm is not paired with an undecayed shuffled arm, so it does not isolate decay.

text: The stored test predictions and accuracies are reproducible: accuracy recomputed from stored predictions matches the records, and an independent from-scratch retrain reproduces all arm records on checkpoint hash, predictions, IDs, accuracy and loss history.
limitations: Post-hoc audit performed after the registered comparison, so it is exploratory by the protocol rules. Reproduction holds on this machine and CUDA build only.

text: Baselines on the test split: a logistic regression reaches an accuracy close to, but below, the MLP arms, and the class-prior floor is near chance. The task is learnable by a linear model, and the MLP is not operating at a trivial level.
limitations: The logistic baseline has a single seed and was not tuned under a separate protocol. The difference from the MLP is descriptive, not a tested hypothesis.

text: Decay does change the optimisation trajectory: train and validation loss histories differ from the unregularized arm by a small but non-zero amount at every seed, even though test predictions are identical.
limitations: Derived from a summary file, not a registered endpoint. Loss differences are continuous and depend on the single fixed learning rate.

text: The decoupled decay shrinks weights in the direction the update rule predicts, by a small amount relative to the weight norm over the 850-step run. This is the mechanistic reason C1 is near-null under the registered constants.
limitations: Weight-level analysis of one trained configuration per arm. The predicted shrink follows from the update formula and the registered constants, not from an intervention on the decay term alone.

text: This design can only resolve accuracy differences above a minimum detectable effect set by the test size (n=360) and the seed-to-seed spread. Smaller effects are inconclusive here, and an inconclusive primary interval is the expected outcome for a near-null intervention.
limitations: The minimum-detectable-effect figure was computed in the research phase from binomial standard errors and the observed seed spread, not from a registered power analysis. It is an approximation.

text: Post hoc, the decay arm has a slightly higher test negative log-likelihood than the unregularized arm, with a bootstrap interval that excludes zero. The continuous metric shows a small effect where accuracy shows none.
limitations: Not a registered endpoint and chosen after the primary result was known, so it cannot be promoted to confirmatory. Direction and size need a pre-registered continuous endpoint in a new cycle.

text: The implementation passes its checks: the decoupled-decay step is verified with a zero-gradient test, and `study.py check` split sizes match the registered fixture.
limitations: Checks cover the properties tested, not the full training loop. The shuffled-label permutation is only indirectly checked through C3.

text: Code audit: the fixture's reload check and prediction step run eval-mode forward passes on test features, so the test split is not used only for final metrics. No test label was found in the training or model-selection paths read.
limitations: Found by reading the code, not by a runtime leakage test. Disclosed in reports/pilot.md and not fixed in this cycle, because study.py is the immutable fixture.
